description: Look a job up by id and, if it has finished, save its results. Use after a tool answered before its job was done.

job_id.description: The job_id an earlier call answered with.

output_dir.description: Directory for the results. Defaults to beside a local source. A URL source has no "beside": without this the answer carries temporary links.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to keep waiting if it is still running (default 0, at most 240).

name: check_job
title: Check a job
